request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Stewardship and economic foundations for launch
Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness for a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The bridge is on testnet under Catalyst Fund 14 and is intended to prove the architecture end-to-end on Bitcoin Testnet4 and Cardano Preprod by August 2026.
The proposers request ₳12,332,031, described as approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Custody of locked BTC is claimed to be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with fund movement requiring a cryptographic threshold representing a majority of delegated stake.
If SPO coordination fails, Bifrost claims a federated mode can activate as an operational fallback.
Bifrost claims fBTC will be issued and burned in 1:1 correspondence with BTC locked in the Bifrost custody script on Bitcoin and will be usable as a native Cardano token.
The proposal states Bifrost has no bridge token, no founder allocation, Apache 2.0 open-source components, public reporting, and an independent stewardship structure to be determined in Phase 1.
The proposal targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029.

The proposal says Catalyst Fund 14 funded Bifrost with ₳739,000, 585 approving votes, and deliverables covering architecture, testnet MVP, and documentation on a December 2025 to August 2026 timeline.

summary: The document presents a large Phase 1 treasury request for launch-readiness work on a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, with detailed technical architecture claims but many core security, custody, adoption, and stewardship assertions remaining proposer-stated within the supplied text.
